source_note: Original remake composition from retained catalog species; not a recovered historical player team or boss encounter. The retained catalog uses Nattsu39/seer_data H5 commit a00bcdd and may include later base-stat revisions. All members use ordinary level-100 formulas, IV 31, total EV 510, neutral nature, finite natural PP, and no HP or stat overrides. Only original-form species 70 uses explicitly recovered training-reward moves; every other equipped move is learned naturally by level 100.
design_notes: Roster groups describe origin and tactical identity, not a guaranteed linear difficulty ranking.
